name: kucoin-mcp
description: KuCoin (spot) (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endp

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every spot symbol (BTC-USDT style); paged locally; query is a substring of symbol/base/quote.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: 24h statistics; volume is the 24h base volume.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval: 1m 3m 5m 15m 30m 1h 2h 4h 6h 8h 12h 1d 1w 1M. Newest first; at most 1500 per call; the newest `limit` are returned.
